distribution.narrative: Lin et al. (2024) adds Xizang to the previously known Fujian occurrence. Smith et al. (2022) independently supports Fujian and adds locality evidence from Fujian, Sanming City; it adds no new province to the current synthesis.

host_note: Lin et al. (2024) directly reports Quercus × leana. Smith et al. (2022) reports no host in the integrated record; the existing host is retained.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Xylosandrus jaintianus (Schedl, 1967).
